additionalConfirmedFindings.source: Qodo review5721583693 / discussion4430774694 at the same head
additionalConfirmedFindings.problem: One invalid saved document suppressed unrelated valid re-reviews in the same load.
additionalConfirmedFindings.fix: Merge each successful per-record verdict; invalid records stay unreviewable and deletable, and loading does not rewrite either original record. Existing plaintext cleanup remains.
validation: Both listing orders reproduce RED then pass GREEN. Existing invalid-record deletion, original-byte preservation and retained-buffer cleanup tests remain.

additionalConfirmedFindings.source: Source review adjacent to Sonar CLI path claims; separate from the safe CLI --run sink
additionalConfirmedFindings.problem: An editable planned-state trade.label x/../../escaped caused actual runTrades to overwrite a pre-existing terms-review file outside its trades directory before any transaction. Reproduction used an auto-removed temporary root, synthetic keys and intercepted RPC; no repository evidence or live network was touched.
additionalConfirmedFindings.fix: Require exactly one release and one refund slot before any planned trade negotiation. Explicit operator-selected statePath remains allowed.
validation: Malicious, duplicate, missing and null labels produce STATE_MISMATCH with no state/output writes or send. Valid labels still negotiate beside an explicitly chosen state path.

additionalConfirmedFindings.source: Qodo review5721583693 / discussion4430774699 at the same head
additionalConfirmedFindings.problem: A null owner key ID accepted any self-consistent replacement release key and trust bundle for a testnet build/runtime; the default null value did not authenticate an independently approved owner key.
additionalConfirmedFindings.fix: Default build, runtime and CLI verification fail closed when the owner pin is unset. Explicit locally trusted fixture-key verification uses a distinct local-proof build/source label; it does not supply a production owner trust decision and trading stays disabled.
validation: Two-key replacement regression rejects a substituted key/bundle and default unpinned admission.
TypeScript and testnet browser checks passed; local canonical browser7, kit9 and trade13 proofs passed as reported by the source owner and independent review.

additionalConfirmedFindings.source: Whole-repository sibling search after four Sonar label findings
additionalConfirmedFindings.problem: The same capture-label path escape existed in four unannotated sibling runners.
additionalConfirmedFindings.fix: Apply the identical portable component guard to every dynamically discovered historical capture runner. Preserve prior logs and receipts.
validation: Valid capture filenames, stdout, receipts and nonzero child exit propagation remain unchanged; unsafe labels neither write nor launch a child.

otherHostedReviewLimits.reason: A permanently rejecting native recipient cannot complete payment in the isolated escrow profile, whose reverted payment keeps the recorded principal/liability intact. No recipient-authorized alternate payout ABI was added in this closure. This is retained as a local-only profile qualification limitation; it is not dismissed or claimed fixed, and does not transfer qualification from the separate contracts/evm escrow profile.

The pure call builders do not read chain time. The current Sepolia send composition calls checkFundingWindow with chain time before funding, while generic future send compositions must supply the same freshness preflight. No claim is made that the encoding helper itself rejects expired terms or that this is an enabled production trading flow.
